title: contao/core-bundle: Non-admin users can self-grant permissions that implicitly make them administrators…
description: A vulnerability in contao/core-bundle allows delegated non-admin user managers to escalate privileges by self-granting the 'theme_import' permission, which enables arbitrary PHP code execution on the server. This bypasses protections introduced in version 5.7.3 that restricted non-admin users from accessing the 'tpl_editor' module. The flaw affects versions prior to 5.3.50 and between 5.4.0-RC1 and 5.7.12, and it has been fixed in versions 5.3.50 and 5.7.12.
